bathAction.title: Sit
bathAction.tooltip: Sit, so the hands can reach the legs and groin. Half a minute.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(sit)] and [npc.verb(draw)] one knee up, which puts [npc.her] hands where the standing pose would not. Water pools around [npc.herHim]. [npc.speech(Better. I can actually reach from here.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(drop)] down into a sit and [npc.verb(spread)] [npc.her] knees a little, already pleased at how much of [npc.herHim] [npc.she] can get to. [npc.speech(Oh, yes. This opens everything up.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(sit)] down hard and [npc.verb(plant)] [npc.her] feet so [npc.she] can reach without any more shifting about. [npc.speech(Sitting. Now wash it.)]
